About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

As In-House Counsel, you will serve as the company’s top legal advisor and a strategic business partner to the executive team, reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer. We embrace challenges and try new things, always looking for ways to improve. We deliver technology products and services enabled everywhere, so business can happen anywhere. Description:


IT governance, risk, and compliance sit at the center of how Houlihan Lokey protects client trust and operates as a global financial institution. As a GRC Analyst, you help ensure that the technology powering the firm's business runs on a foundation of strong controls, sound risk management, and continuous regulatory readiness — work that matters more with every new regulation, threat, and client expectation the industry takes on.


Working alongside a Lead GRC Analyst and reporting to the IT GRC Manager, you will support governance, risk, and compliance efforts spanning frameworks such as GDPR, DORA, and Sarbanes-Oxley, partnering with internal and external auditors and control owners across the enterprise. It's an ideal opportunity for someone with 2–3 years of GRC or IT audit experience who wants to build a career at the intersection of technology, risk, and financial services, inside a team that will invest in your growth from day one.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of IT governance frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist in identifying, evaluating, and tracking IT risks — including cybersecurity, data privacy, and operational risk — and contribute to risk mitigation plans that address identified vulnerabilities.
  • Partner with HL Compliance to ensure IT systems align with regulations such as GDPR, DORA, and SOX, and other standards relevant to the financial services industry.
  • Conduct assurance activities, including security assessments and issue management, and collaborate with IT teams to strengthen security compliance and the overall control environment.
  • Plan and execute IT audits that evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, risk management, and governance processes, supporting remediation tracking under the guidance of the Lead GRC Analyst and IT GRC Manager.
  • Prepare clear, well-organized reports and documentation on IT governance, risk, and compliance activities for review by team leadership.
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders — including auditors, regulators, and clients — on GRC-related matters, including timely, accurate responses to client security questionnaires.
  • Support the development of IT governance and compliance training materials in partnership with IT, Compliance, and Audit teams.
  • Contribute to vendor risk management, including assessing SOC reports and ISO certifications and applying a clear understanding of vendor risk tiering.

Qualifications & Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of experience in IT governance, risk management, compliance, or IT audit, ideally within the financial services industry.
  • Working knowledge of IT regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, DORA, and SOX, or comparable international standards.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and help mitigate risk effectively.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Progress toward, or interest in, professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, Security+, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with GRC or audit management platforms and tools.
  • Awareness of NIST and COBIT frameworks.
  • Strong Excel skills, including data management and functions such as VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, and XMATCH.
  • Experience preparing materials for internal and external audit requests.
  • Understanding of vendor risk management, including SOC report and ISO certification review.

Soft Skills:

  • Communicate with clarity and professionalism, balancing accuracy with approachability across a range of audiences.
  • Bring a solutions-focused mindset, willing to go above and beyond to create positive outcomes.
  • Demonstrate high emotional intelligence, staying calm, positive, and thoughtful in challenging situations.
  • Approach work with curiosity and a growth-oriented mindset, continuously building GRC and technical expertise.
  • Operate with a high degree of professionalism and dependability, with a commitment to the firm's mission and values.
  • Stay comfortable working with AI-enabled GRC, audit, and analytics tools, using them to streamline risk assessments, control testing, and reporting.
  • Bring curiosity to new technologies, proactively identifying opportunities to automate or streamline governance, risk, and compliance workflows.

Senior Content & Thought Leadership Manager

ASC Global | Remote / Hybrid | Full-time

Most content in our industry is forgettable. We want to change that.

ASC Global works at the centre of the global electronic components supply chain. We help OEMs, manufacturers, data-centre operators and MRO organisations find hard-to-source, end-of-life and shortage parts. Every day we see what is really happening in the market, and we want to start telling that story.

We're looking for a senior B2B content leader to build and run our thought leadership from the ground up. This is not a social media role. It's for someone who understands a complex technical industry, finds the story nobody else is telling, and makes engineers and procurement executives stop scrolling.

What you'll do

  • Build two voices. Shape and grow our CEO's personal LinkedIn presence alongside ASC Global's thought leadership strategy.
  • Interview and translate. Meet regularly with our CEO and internal experts. Turn their opinions, experience and market observations into sharp, publishable content.
  • Own the big ideas. Track trends in AI infrastructure, data centres, semiconductors, component shortages, EOL products, MRO, energy infrastructure and supply-chain disruption, and develop clear points of view on them.
  • Turn data into insight. Work with ASC's internal data to find proprietary trends worth publishing, without exposing confidential customer information.
  • Create content that earns attention. Produce industry reports, articles, LinkedIn posts, newsletters, carousels and video concepts, with headlines and hooks that executives actually read.
  • Multiply every idea. Turn one major report into a full campaign across LinkedIn, Instagram, our website, email and other channels.
  • Prove it works. Track followers, engagement, website traffic, inbound enquiries, RFQs and, ultimately, revenue generated by content.
  • Lead a small team. Manage and mentor a Junior Content/Social Media Coordinator, and coordinate freelance video and design talent.

Who you are

  • You have 5-8+ years of B2B content, editorial or thought leadership experience in a technical industry. Relevant areas include semiconductors, electronic components, data centres, AI infrastructure, industrial, manufacturing, aviation or similar.
  • You're a strong writer and editor who can make complex subjects clear and compelling without dumbing them down.
  • You're a natural interviewer. You know how to draw out a subject-matter expert's best thinking and shape it into a narrative.
  • You're research-driven and curious. You read industry news because you want to, not because you have to.
  • You've ghostwritten or built an executive's personal brand before, and you can capture someone else's voice.
  • You think commercially. You care about pipeline and revenue, not just likes.
  • You're comfortable working directly with leadership and owning a strategy end to end.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to procurement, supply chain or the independent distribution market
  • Experience producing data-led reports or market research
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn analytics, CRM attribution and email platforms

This role is not for you if your main experience is scheduling posts and managing community comments. We need a strategist, storyteller and researcher first.

Why join

  • You'll report directly to the CEO, with real influence and a seat at the table.
  • You'll build a function from scratch, with a team and a budget behind you.
  • You'll get first-hand access to market intelligence most content professionals never see.
  • Compensation is competitive and based on experience and industry knowledge.

To apply: In your CV link 2-3 samples of technical B2B content you've written: a report, article or executive LinkedIn posts.
